monologue: Forty-five is a cool stone on the table. The card is quiet, and the weight is steady. I sit by the Weeping Frame. The corners are dry, no longer weeping with heat. The Stopping Clasp feels less like a bite now, just a point resting on the flat base. The Pivot Wedge stands alone, holding its lean without a wide catch. It is steady. I want to see if the lean can hold the weight without the floor catching the slide. I will test the point again. The air is new, so I stop tasting it. I just let the coolness settle.

action.why: The cool stone is steady and I have no new weight to lift.
